signature_moves: Desktop-lensing glass bar — the floating strip refracts the wallpaper behind it (desktop-as-material); floating bar glass + opaque widget faces honors the Liquid-Glass Golden Rule in spirit
Dock-as-widget-canvas — the horizontal Dock/Touch-Bar footprint reframed as a live-widget strip, inheriting Dock muscle memory (Jakob's Law)
Glance-first tabular typography applied ~50x consistently (Bold numeric value + quiet caption)
Real dogfooding as demo data — Linear 'ENG-128 Fix dock tooltip clipping' card = the dev's own live tracker
Apple-keynote cosplay on the cover (brand layer, not app UI): Apple-logo eyebrow + ultra-bold black keynote headline + hyperreal Apple-wallpaper nature hero
defects: Contrast Dilution (borderline) — tertiary captions on #000 and glance text on the glass bar over busy wallpapers approach the 4.5:1 floor; legibility depends on wallpaper
UI Contrast (#10) — card fill #0A0A0A on #000 (~4% lift) + hairline dark-on-dark cell dividers <3:1; cards separate almost only by radius
Target Starvation (mild) — ~20px app-launcher glyphs and small transport/edit circles near the 24px WCAG floor
Glass-on-glass risk (insufficient-evidence) — per-cell lensing on the bar may read as glass-in-content; not confirmable from stills

aesthetic.direction: WidgetKit/iOS-widget glance-language transplanted to a Mac desktop bar — neo-grotesque-product dark canvas (near-black ramp + saturated per-app accents, glass panels) crossed with consumer-widget playfulness; not a native macOS window aesthetic
peers: iStat Menus / One Thing menubar utilities

psychology: Jakob's Law — widget faces copy Apple/iOS widget conventions exactly, so users read them instantly (borrowed familiarity); the Dock footprint reuses trained muscle memory
Von Restorff / signal-detection — each face uses ONE saturated hue against black so the glance value pops pre-attentively
Hierarchy via de-emphasis (Refactoring UI) — big tabular value + quiet gray caption on every tile; the number speaks, the label whispers
Choice overload NOT violated — the ~50-tile catalog (shot-2) is a browse/catalog surface, where option density is a feature, not a decision point
Miller/Cowan chunking — each widget = one glanceable chunk; the bar caps visible widgets to ~5-8
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — high-polish keynote-grade presentation buys first-contact trust (marketing cover especially)
notes: All four inputs are marketing/catalog composites of a real shipping app (dock.cool, paid), NOT standard app-window screenshots and NOT mocks — no window chrome (traffic lights/menu bar/sidebar/toolbar) appears, so host FRAMEWORK LINEAGE IS UNVERIFIABLE (recorded unknown/low). Design LANGUAGE is confidently WidgetKit/iOS-widget grammar with custom-drawn faces + a Liquid-Glass-influenced lensing bar. IMPORTANT for synthesis: exclude from macOS native canon and native style clusters — a widget-catalog/Dock-strip surface is not window-native evidence; its glance-type density and solid-fill today-chip selection are widget-surface properties, not macOS defects. Cover splits into two evidence types: the dock bar (product/design evidence) vs the Apple-cosplay backdrop+headline (brand evidence) — do not conflate. Positive platform signal: streak/ring green #3DB45B sits on the system-green swatch (#30D158). Notable modern touch: an AI 'Thinking... 1m39s' live-status widget (fits the 'smart second Dock' positioning). Measurements are display-scale estimates from ~2000px composites; halve if renders are @2x. Corpus still Novice — this is the first app profile; single-app, zero promotions.
